verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party docs describe Seer/Autofix as an AI debugging agent that will "automatically root-cause any issue" and "find root causes and generate suggested code fixes." Its root cause analysis can be sent on to coding agents (e.g. Cursor) for fixes and PRs, which makes the result directly actionable. Suspect commits exist as a separate issue feature, but the evidence does not say Seer analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs or related commits. Seer also requires a paid subscription. Missing for 10: documentation of which issue context Seer analyzes (stack trace, breadcrumbs, commits), independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause quality.
